releaseNotes: 6D6X6 2.5.125.0: H.264 hardware MFT uses an effectively infinite GOP (8388607 pictures), removing periodic IDR bursts while preserving explicit recovery IDR requests from PLI/FIR, reliable control and quality changes. Peak-constrained VBR uses a 150 ms bitrate-scaled buffer. NativeV2 ABI 2.5 remains unchanged, SHA-256 494fbf955febf469e022febc47ea3b236b4740fe0c3e8f4ab6ad265431adc1b5.
